description: TrollBridge is an x402 pay-per-call intel gateway with 64 lanes — no subscription, USDC on Base or Solana. This skill exposes its five pre-trade safety lanes for Base tokens: /contract-check, a heuristic contract safety screen returning a 0-100 risk score (explicitly NOT an audit); /honeypot; /rug-score; /approval-screen; and /tx-dryrun. Each lane returns machine-readable JSON so a Bankr agent can decide whether a token, approval, or transaction is safe to touch before it trades.
shortDescription: Pay-per-call x402 safety screens for Base tokens: contract check, honeypot, rug score, approval screen, tx dry-run

demo.title: trollbridge.sh
demo.code:
# Screen a fresh Base token before buying (contract-check $0.10 + honeypot $0.02 + rug-score $0.02 = $0.14)
# Step 1: request a lane - the service replies 402 with USDC payment instructions
curl -s -X POST https://mini-tollbooth.onrender.com/honeypot \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"chain":"base","token_address":"0x..."}'

# Step 2: pay the quoted USDC amount on Base or Solana via your x402 stack,
# then retry with the payment header - the service returns the screening result
# (machine-readable JSON with risk scores and flags)

# Chain the lanes: contract-check before a first buy, approval-screen before
# signing an approval, tx-dryrun before submitting a transaction.
# Screens are heuristic checks, NOT audits - a clean screen never proves a token is safe.

install.description: No installation needed — TrollBridge is a hosted x402 API. Call lanes over HTTPS at https://mini-tollbooth.onrender.com and pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana.
